import sys

def main():
    line = sys.stdin.readline()
    if not line:
        return
    n = int(line.strip())
    if n == 0:
        print("None")
        return
    
    elements = []
    for _ in range(n):
        elem = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
        elements.append(elem)
    
    if not elements:
        print("None")
        return
    
    # Try to parse as integers first
    try:
        nums = [int(x) for x in elements]
        max_val = max(nums)
        print(f"Maximum: {max_val}")
        return
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    # Try to parse as floats
    try:
        floats = [float(x) for x in elements]
        max_val = max(floats)
        # Check if all values are whole numbers
        if all(f == int(f) for f in floats):
            max_val = int(max_val)
        print(f"Maximum: {max_val}")
        return
    except ValueError:
        pass
    
    # Fall back to string comparison
    max_val = max(elements)
    print(f"Maximum: {max_val}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
